title: Social Media Analyst
description:
Hiring: Social Media Analyst (D2C Skincare)
  
Company: 4Mation Skins (4Mation Biosciences Pvt. Ltd.)
  
Role: Social Media Analyst
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Location: On-site (New Town, Kolkata)
  
  
About 4Mation Skins:
  
  
At 4Mation Skins, we are redefining modern skincare through high-efficacy, science-backed multi-active formulations. We blend dermatological precision with engaging digital storytelling. As our direct-to-consumer (D2C) presence scales rapidly across channels, data-driven decisions are at the core of how we engage, educate, and convert our community.
  
  
We are looking for an analytical, trend-conscious Social Media Analyst to join our team on-site in New Town, Kolkata, to decode user behavior, measure content performance, and uncover actionable growth levers.
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
If you look beyond vanity metrics, love connecting engagement numbers directly to customer behavior and revenue, and enjoy dissecting why a specific hook, audio, or format performed exceptionally well, this role is for you.
  
  
You will work closely with our creative, marketing, and founder teams to turn complex social data into clear, actionable creative and distribution playbooks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
\* Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor, analyze, and report on key social metrics (reach, retention/watch time, engagement rate, saves, shares, profile visits, and CTR) across Instagram, YouTube, and other digital touchpoints.
  
\* Content & Audience Insights: Dissect organic and paid content performance to identify winning hooks, optimal post frequencies, formats, and creative fatigue.
  
\* Trend & Competitor Intelligence: Benchmark competitor strategies, analyze industry D2C skincare trends, and spot emerging creative formats and audience discussions early.
  
\* Social Listening & Sentiment Analysis: Track brand mentions, customer conversations, and product sentiment to surface insights that inform product messaging and customer care.
  
\* Collaboration with Creative Teams: Partner with the Social Media Manager and creative crew to provide clear data-backed recommendations for shoot concepts, video hooks, and asset optimization.
  
\* Attribution & Growth Funnel: Track social-to-store customer journeys (traffic, link-in-bio conversions, promo code traction) to quantify social media ROI.
  
  
What We’re Looking For ?
  
  
\* Analytical Background: 1–3 years of experience analyzing social media performance, digital marketing campaigns, or e-commerce audience engagement.
  
  
\* Tool Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of native platform analytics (Instagram Insights, YouTube Analytics, Meta Business Suite) along with social listening or reporting tools (e.g., Notion, Google Looker Studio, or advanced Excel/Sheets).
  
  
\* Creative + Data Mindset: Ability to translate raw spreadsheets into visual summaries and clear creative directives that non-technical creators can immediately apply.
  
  
\* Deep Social Understanding: Strong familiarity with how social algorithms work—especially short-form video retention dynamics.
  
\* Location: Must be based in or willing to work on-site in New Town, Kolkata.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
\* High Ownership: Your insights won’t get lost in bureaucracy—they will directly shape the creative roadmap and marketing investments.
  
\* Fast-Paced D2C Culture: Experience firsthand how a science-led personal care brand scales across digital and omnichannel platforms.
  
\* Direct Access: Work closely with cross-functional leadership, creative managers, and founders in an open, agile environment.
  
  
How to Apply ?
  
  
Ready to turn data into high-performing brand impact?
  
👉 Apply directly on LinkedIn or email your CV and a sample report/case study of past analytical work to:
  
📩 operations@4mationskins.com
  
Subject line: Application: Social Media Analyst - [Your Name]

As our Account Director, you won't just be managing account—you’ll be the architect of digital evolution for some of India's most influential industrial giants. We are looking for a visionary who can talk tech over tea, pitch automation while sipping espresso, and turn complex industrial challenges into a five-star digital experience.
  
  
If you believe the future of industry is smart, sustainable, and slightly spicy, we’ve saved you a seat at the table. We are specifically looking for the leader who doesn't wait for things to happen; if there's a traffic jam, you're the one getting out of the vehicle to clear the way forward.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Ecosystem & GTM Orchestration: Drive a "whole ecosystem" strategy by collaborating with various Go-To-Market channels, including System Integrators, Distributors, and Strategic Alliances, to fulfill complex customer requirements.
* Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts, building deep, trust-based partnerships with key stakeholders.
* Business Architecture: Co-create impactful digital transformation strategies by deeply understanding the customer’s business models, operational challenges, and long-term goals.
* Value Proposition Execution: Collaborate with internal teams—Solution Architects, Portfolio Managers, and Marketing—to deliver tailored propositions that address industry-specific needs like energy efficiency and production agility.
* Innovation Leadership: Introduce customers to cutting-edge technologies, including AI, IoT, and digital enterprise solutions, while translating technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Performance Tracking: Achieve Order Intake (OI), revenue, and customer satisfaction targets while maintaining accurate pipeline visibility using CRM tools like SieSales or SFDC.

**What You Need To Make a Real Impact**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field; an MBA is an added advantage, however not mandatory.
* Experience: 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within the Automation, Digital Solutions, or large-scale Industrial sectors.
* Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and deliver consistent business growth through both technical and commercial innovation.
* Ecosystem Expertise: A strong understanding of how to leverage external partners (SIs/Distributors) to provide a comprehensive solution to the end-customer.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills; we are looking for more of a "giver" than a "taker."
* Tech Proficiency: High comfort level with CRM tools and digital sales platforms.

**Why Join Us?**
You will have the autonomy to navigate some of the most significant industrial portfolios in the country while being backed by a global leader in digital innovation. We offer a seat at the table where your strategies will directly influence the future of smart infrastructure in India. #SL

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

alongside vital

. You will champion our

and

* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections

A healthier future drives us to innovate. **PURPOSE OF ROLE**
To program manage the delivery, scaling and adoption of enterprise AI intelligence products that can translate business requirements into trusted insights and actionable recommendations for business leaders. The role bridges stakeholders, product, data, analytics, and technology teams to define use cases, align roadmaps, implement features, and ensure the products create measurable business impact.
  
  
**Key Tasks And Accountabilities**

* Own end-to-end program management for conversational AI intelligence products, from intake and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and performance tracking.
* Lead a high performance team to advance on the strategy of build, buy and integrate agents to build world class AI intelligence products
* Partner with business stakeholders to capture requirements, clarify success metrics, translate needs into product-ready user stories, and manage trade-offs across scope, timing, and impact.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, data engineers, UX, analytics, and technology teams to implement features that are accurate, usable, secure, and scalable.
* Build and maintain delivery roadmaps, sprint/release plans, dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and executive-ready status reporting.

* BUSINESS ENVIRONMENT

**Main Characteristics:**
This role operates in a fast-moving AI product environment where business teams need practical intelligence products that improve decision-making, automate insight access, and create repeatable ways of working. The role requires strong program discipline, stakeholder management, product fluency, and enough technical understanding to partner effectively with data and engineering teams.
  
  
Geographical Scope: Global / Zone scope depending on product portfolio and deployment roadmap.
  
  
**Key Dimensions and Contacts:**
Business stakeholders and functional leaders who sponsor use cases and define adoption needs.
  
  
Product leaders and product managers responsible for roadmap, prioritization, user experience, and release planning.
  
  
Data science, data engineering, analytics engineering, platform, architecture, security, and privacy teams responsible for implementation and governance.
  
  
Analytics, insights, commercial, revenue management, marketing, operations, and transformation teams as end users and adoption partners.
  
  
External technology or implementation partners where needed to accelerate delivery while protecting product ownership and avoiding vendor lock-in.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience, Skills**
Please list the following requirements
  
  
**Level of educational attainment required:**

* BS degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Business, or related field. MBA, Masters degree, product management certification, or agile/program management certification preferred.

**Previous work experience required:**

* 6+ years of relevant business, product, analytics, technology, or consulting experience, including experience managing cross-functional delivery programs. Experience with AI, GenAI, conversational products, analytics products, data platforms, or digital transformation strongly preferred. CPG or enterprise-scale technology experience is a plus.

**Language skills required:**

**IT skills required:**

Ability to work with product, data science, data engineering, UX, architecture, security, and privacy teams without needing to be the technical implementer.

**Other skills required:**

* Program management: delivery planning, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, executive communication, prioritization, and change control.
* Business analysis: ability to translate ambiguous business needs into requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and product backlog items.
* Product mindset: customer empathy, adoption focus, iterative delivery, value measurement, and continuous improvement.
* AI delivery discipline: understanding of responsible AI practices, data readiness, answer-quality evaluation, human review, governance, and model/product performance monitoring.
* Communication: exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to business audiences and business trade-offs clearly to technical teams.
* Collaboration: strong relationship-building, influencing, negotiation, and facilitation skills across senior stakeholders and execution teams.
* Operating style: comfortable with ambiguity, able to create structure quickly, and resilient in a dynamic environment with evolving AI capabilities and business priorities.

title: Head Channel Strategy
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Head of Channel Strategy** 




*Owner of secondary \& tertiary counter billing strategy, counter share and reach* 




**Position** 




 Channel Strategy Head
 



**Function** 




 Sales and Marketing, Channel Strategy
 



**Grade / Level** 




 Assistant Vice President (AVP)
 



**Reports to** 




 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer
 



**Directly leads** 




 Lead, Counter Share and Lead, Reach
 



**Location** 




 Kolkata head office with field travel
 



**Experience** 




 12 years and above in building materials retail channel strategy
 



  





**1\. Why this role exists** 




 SRMB tracks its business through primary billing to the depot or distributor and secondary movement to the dealer. What it does not track is tertiary: the actual sell\-out at the root retail counter to the mason, contractor and home builder. That is the single largest blind spot in the commercial engine. When the counter sale is invisible, demand planning runs on stale proxies, counter potential stays unmapped, and share is lost one counter at a time without anyone seeing it happen.
 



 This role fixes that. The Channel Strategy Head makes root counter billing a measured, managed number, then uses it to drive two outcomes at once: a deeper share of each counter we already serve, and a wider presence in the counters we should serve but do not. Digital is the thread that stitches these efforts together for maximum reach at the lowest cost to serve.
 



  





**2\. The mandate** 




**Three jobs sit under one leader.** 



* **Root counter billing efficacy.** 
 Stand up tertiary tracking as a first\-class metric. Define what a tracked counter looks like, roll out the capture discipline through the field and the DMS, and turn counter billing into the number the zone reviews every week, not an afterthought behind primary and secondary.
* **Lead Counter Share.** 
 Grow SRMB's wallet share at every active counter through range selling across TMT, WINGRIP, the binding range and Real\-Edge, better counter productivity, and the recovery of dormant counters. Own the counter share pod.
* **Lead Reach.** 
 Expand numeric reach into high\-potential counters where SRMB is absent, guided by a live potential map, and use digital demand capture to pull those counters open. Own the reach pod.



  





**3\. Key responsibilities** 



* **Build the tertiary layer.** 
 Design and institutionalize root counter billing tracking so tertiary offtake is captured, trusted and acted on at counter, town, district and zone level.
* **Map counter potential.** 
 Build and maintain a district\-level potential map of where SRMB should be present: counter universe, category demand, competitor hold and white space, so reach decisions are made on data, not on habit.
* **Own demand planning at the edge.** 
 Convert tertiary signals into counter and district level demand forecasts that feed production, stocking and dispatch, and raise forecast accuracy season on season.
* **Stitch the digital effort.** 
 Bring DMS, field force automation, geo\-tagging, influencer and loyalty programs and demand\-generation martech into one connected flow, so counter data, offtake and reach campaigns reinforce each other for maximum reach.
* **Drive counter share and range selling.** 
 Set and chase share\-of\-counter targets, lift lines billed per counter, and shrink the dormant\-counter base.
* **Lead and build two pods.** 
 Recruit, coach and hold accountable the Counter Share and Reach teams, and set the cadence of counter reviews with zonal and area teams.



  





**4\. Key result areas** 




**Result area** 




**How success is measured** 




  





**Tertiary visibility** 




 Share of active counters with tracked, trusted root billing; from near zero today to the agreed coverage target
 



**Counter share** 




 SRMB wallet share per counter and lines billed per counter (range selling index)
 



**Reach** 




 Numeric reach, new counter additions and white\-space closure against the potential map
 



**Demand planning** 




 Counter and district level forecast accuracy, and reduction in stock\-outs and dead inventory
 



**Digital adoption** 




 Active DMS and field\-force usage, share of counters geo\-tagged and digitally billed
 



**Counter productivity** 




 Revenue per active counter and reduction in the dormant\-counter base
 



  





**5\. Who we are looking for** 



* 12 years and above in retail channel strategy in the building materials industry: steel, cement, paints, tiles, pipes or construction chemicals. A minimum of 10 to 12 years is non\-negotiable.
* Proven command of primary, secondary and, above all, tertiary sales, with hands\-on experience making counter sell\-out a tracked number.
* Strong demand planning credentials, from field signal to forecast to stocking decision.
* A track record of counter potential mapping and white\-space expansion across multi\-district geographies.
* Practical experience rolling out DMS, field force automation and digital demand generation, and getting the field to actually use them.
* MBA or equivalent preferred. Comfort with data and dashboards is expected, not optional. Willing to spend real time in the field where counters live.



  





**6\. What good looks like in year one** 




 Root counter billing is a live, reviewed number across priority zones. The potential map is built and reach is expanding against it, not against gut feel. Demand planning is running off tertiary signal, and the two pods are staffed, capable and hitting counter share and reach targets. Digital tools are adopted in the field, not sitting idle. In short, the counter stops being a blind spot and becomes SRMB's sharpest source of growth.

title: Business Head
description:
**Company Description** 
 Prorata is India’s first fractional car ownership platform, enabling individuals to co\-own their dream car by investing as little as 8\.33% of its total cost for leisure and lifestyle purposes. The model follows a no loan, no EMI, no down payment, and no rent policy, making aspirational car ownership more accessible. Each car is divided into 12 ownership tickets, with each ticket providing 30 days of usage per year for five years, and co\-owners receive resale value based on their ownership share when the car is auctioned after five years. Depending on usage needs, customers can buy multiple tickets to increase their annual access, and Prorata forms local co\-owner groups within a defined radius. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. Large electrical / fire contractors \- System integrators End users and facility owners. Influence consultant specifications and approvals to position company products as preferred solutions.  Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
   

  

 As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
   

  

 You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare \| Medical Technology \| Digital Transformation \| Business Consulting \| Practice Growth \| Customer Success \| Commercial Leadership
   

  

 This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
   

  

**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales \-** 
 At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
   

  

**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare \-** 
 Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry\-leading solutions worldwide.
   

  

**Be Part of India's Growth Story \-** 
 India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.

* Differentiate Align through insight\-led selling rather than price\-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.


**Drive Digital Transformation**

title: GTM Head
description:
**Company Description** 




 EternUp is building the digital twin for human life — an AI operating system that connects your time, work, relationships, health, knowledge and finances into one continuously evolving model of you. Powered by Continuo, our personal context layer, EternUp understands not just what you ask for, but what's happening and what should happen next — then acts on it through Aeon, an AI chief of staff. We're early\-stage and building both the product and the market at the same time.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 As Head of GTM, you'll own go\-to\-market end to end for EternUp's launch — positioning, pricing, channel strategy, and the first cohort of paying users. You'll work directly with the founders to translate the product's differentiators into a message that lands with our core audiences (founders/CEOs, executives, working parents, knowledge workers, investors, travelers, creators), then build the acquisition and retention motion from scratch. This is a founding, hands\-on role: you'll be doing the work yourself in the early days, not managing a team of it. Full\-time hybrid, based in the Kolkata metropolitan area.

* Has taken a consumer or prosumer product from 0 to its first meaningful user base — not just supported an existing GTM machine
* Comfortable owning positioning and messaging directly — can write copy, briefs, and landing pages themselves, not only direct others to
* Data\-literate: sets up and reads acquisition funnels, retention cohorts, and unit economics without needing an analyst
* Experience with early\-stage/low\-budget channels (organic content, communities, creator partnerships, waitlists, PLG loops) over paid\-acquisition\-first thinking
* Comfortable with a category\-defining product — can build a narrative and audience for something that doesn't have an obvious existing comparison
* Startup ownership: moves fast, ships imperfect things, iterates on real user feedback rather than waiting for certainty
* Bonus: experience launching a personal\-AI, productivity, or quantified\-self category product

title: State Head (Wires & Cables)
description:
Job Description \| Regional Sales Manager — Power (State Head, Trade)
   

  

 \*\*Regional Sales Manager — Power\*\*
   

  

 \_Sturlite Voltedge Private Limited \| State Head — Trade Channel \| Pan\-India\_
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Function\*\*
   

  

 Sales \& Business Development — Power Division (Wires, Cables \& Switchgear)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Level\*\*
   

  

 Senior Management (Regional Sales Manager / State Head)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Openings\*\*
   

  

 Multiple positions — one per state / territory (see markets table below)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Location\*\*
   

  

 State capital or key commercial hub within the assigned territory
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Reports To\*\*
   

  

 Joint Business Head — Power (Mr. Suresh Jain \& Mr. Sandeep Kantilal)
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Team Size\*\*
   

  

 Leads 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the assigned state
   

  

 \_\_\*\*Travel\*\*
   

  

 12–15 days per month across the state or cluster
   

  

 \_\_
   

  

 \*\*About Sturlite Electric\*\*
   

  

 Founded in 2009 by Mr. Sanjay Jain and Mr. Mukesh Jain, Sturlite Electric is a Bengaluru\-based electrical products company that has compounded at \~35% CAGR for the better part of a decade — reaching ₹700 Cr ARR through a 16,000\+ partner channel spanning 25 states. The lighting portfolio that built the business is TUV Rheinland\-certified and has earned Sturlite a rare distinction in the Indian electrical trade: a challenger brand that distributors and retailers respect on merit, not on price.
   

  

 Seventeen Years Into The Business, The Founders Are Taking The Brand Into Two New Categories — Committing Greenfield Manufacturing Capital At Kadi, Mehsana (Gujarat) To Do It The Right Way
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Wires \& Cables — house wires (Flamecore\+ FR\-LF, Greencore\+ HR\-FR\-LF, Ultracore\+ HR\-FR\-LSH\-LF) on Class 5 fine\-flexible conductor and 99\.97% electrolytic\-grade copper, manufactured to IS 694 and IS 17048\. Flexible/control cables, submersible cables, and communication cables (CAT 6, telephone, speaker). RoHS\-clean by design, with serialised anti\-counterfeit architecture. \_
* \_Switchgear \& MCBs — miniature circuit breakers, RCCBs, isolators, distribution boards, and the wider modular protection range for residential, commercial, and light industrial use. ISI\-marked and engineered to integrate naturally with the wires range at the panel and the dealer counter. Over the next three to four years, Sturlite will grow into a multi\-category electrical group of ₹2,000 Cr\+ — built on four legs: lighting, wires \& cables, switchgear \& MCBs, and wiring devices. \*\*The team being built for the Power Division defines this next chapter. The Power Division is being built once. The people who build it own how it gets built.\*\* \*\*The Opportunity\*\*


**Role**
 This is not a maintenance role in an established business. It is a state P\&L leadership role in a brand\-new category. The right candidate will:
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Enter a market where Sturlite Power has zero legacy baggage — no old pricing issues, no burned relationships, no stuck stock. \_
* \_Leverage Sturlite's existing lighting dealer network (16,000\+ partners) as a ready entry point for distributor and retailer conversations. \_
* \_Represent a product with genuine quality credentials — ISI\-marked, Class 5 conductor, copper\-pure, competitively positioned against Polycab, Finolex, KEI, and RR Kabel. \_
* \_Have the backing of an established, growth\-oriented company investing seriously in the category — trade schemes, BTL support, the Sumangal electrician loyalty programme, and Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador. \_
* \_Build a team of ASMs and TSIs over time — this role is a state P\&L owner from Day 1, growing into a multi\-state mandate in Phase 2\.


 \*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*
   

  

 \*\*1\\. Revenue \& P\&L Ownership\*\*
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Achieve revenue plan (monthly, quarterly, annual) for the full portfolio — house wire, flexible, submersible, communication cables, and switchgear / MCBs. \_
* \_Maintain portfolio mix discipline across the full range, tracking the Y1 baseline to Y3 steady\-state trajectory. \_
* \_Manage credit and collections at state level; keep DSO within company norms (≤ 45 days). \_
* \_Conduct monthly business review with Joint BH — performance, market intel, and escalations. \*\*2\\. Team Leadership — ASMs \& TSIs\*\* \_
* \_Lead a team of 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the state — hire, train, develop, and retain. \_
* \_Assign zone territories, set targets, build beat plans; conduct joint market visits and weekly reviews. \_
* \_Coach ASMs on distributor management, SKU\-mix discipline, and Sturlite's competitive positioning. \_
* \_Build a team culture of ownership, field discipline, and commercial accountability from Day 1\. \*\*3\\. Distributor Strategy \& Channel Health\*\* \_
* \_Own distributor strategy for the state — appointment, ROI management, performance reviews, conflict resolution. \_
* \_Map the state's electrical wholesale and distribution landscape; identify and prioritise the right distributor profile for Sturlite Power. \_
* \_Ensure distributors are adequately stocked, trained on the product, and motivated to push Sturlite actively. \_
* \_Activate key electrical wholesale hubs — establish Sturlite Power as a visible, credible option at the counter within the first 90 days. \*\*4\\. Sumangal Electrician Programme — State Execution\*\* \_
* \_Execute the centrally\-designed Sumangal electrician loyalty programme at state level; BU Head owns design, RSM owns execution. \_
* \_Drive electrician enrolments, monthly nukkad meets, product demos, and coupon\-to\-order conversion across all zones. \_
* \_Monitor Sumangal ordering velocity — ≥ 25% of enrolled electricians ordering quarterly. \*\*5\\. Strategic Kitty Deployment\*\* \_
* \_Deploy the RSM discretionary strategic kitty — for early\-bird distributor offers, month\-end off\-take pushes, and small schemes to distributors that drive secondary off\-take to retailers. \_
* \_RSM is the sole authority for kitty deployment; ASM and below have no scheme authority. \_
* \_Kitty quantum is set annually by the BU Head; RSM is accountable for ROI (target: ≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed). \*\*6\\. Demand Planning \& Supply Coordination\*\* \_
* \_State\-level demand planning and forecasting; coordinate with manufacturing for monthly supply allocation. \_
* \_Drive new SKU launches and sub\-brand traction — sampling, dealer education, electrician demos. \_
* \_Represent Sturlite at state trade bodies, BIS audits, and electrical contractor associations. \*\*7\\. Brand Visibility \& Market Intelligence\*\* \_
* \_Drive in\-shop visibility — ensure branding materials, product samples, price lists, and display boards are in place at key retail counters. \_
* \_Track competitor activity closely — Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells — monitor pricing, schemes, new launches, and distributor moves in the state. \_
* \_Provide monthly market intelligence reports to the Joint BH team; flag opportunities and threats in real time. \*\*Key Performance Indicators\*\* \_\_\*\*KPI\*\*
* T\*\* Revenue achievement


 \_\_ ≥ 95% of annual plan; ≥ 90% in any quarter
   

  

 \_\_ Monthly
   

  

 \_\_ Portfolio mix discipline
   

  

 \_\_ Per Y1 baseline → Y3 SS trajectory; ±5pp quarterly band
   

  

 \_\_ Quarterly
   

  

 \_\_ Distributor health (ROI score)
   

  

 \_\_ ≥ 18% ROI for ≥ 80% of distributors

 3\+ years \| Kolkata or Surat

**Business Head – Founder's Office** 




 Vikas Medical Devices• Kolkata •Full\-Time, On\-Site
 



 We are hiring for one of the most important roles at Vikas Medical Devices: Business Head \- Founding Partner. This is a high\-exposure, high\-accountability position for someone who wants to learn how a business is actually run – and take ownership of running it. You will work directly alongside the Founding Partner, take over the responsibilities he manages day\-to\-day, and act as his proxy across the organisation. This is not a notes\-and\-calendar role; it is about operating at the highest level of the company, driving execution, and ensuring nothing of importance is allowed to drift.
 



**Role Overview** 




 You will progressively take over the functions the Founding Partner handles personally and own them end\-to\-end – across finance, operations, supply chain, sales and administration. You will be close to the decisions, conversations and priorities that shape the direction of the company, and you will be expected to think and act like an owner.
 



**Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Founding Partner’s proxy and manage the priorities he handles each day.
* Communicate and follow up with stakeholders on commitments and open issues.
* Coordinate internally with senior management and department heads on action points and deliverables.
* Collect, review and consolidate daily reporting from senior management.
* Identify, resolve or escalate finance\-related issues – payments, collections and cost control.
* Handle departmental queries and unblock teams so work keeps moving.
* Track all active projects and ensure they are completed on time.
* Schedule and run review meetings as required, and hold teams accountable to outcomes.
* Build and maintain dashboards and MIS that the business can actually decide on.
* Drive hard, persistent follow\-up – internal and external – until matters are closed.



 In short, anything and everything an entrepreneur would do to keep the business running and moving forward.
 



**What You Will Gain** 



* A real understanding of how a fast\-moving healthcare business operates across sales, service, operations and leadership.
* Direct insight into how critical decisions are made across customers, principals, teams and markets.
* Hands\-on experience driving execution when everything appears important.
* Exposure to how strategy moves from discussion to action.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 3–5 years in strategy, business analytics, founder’s office, CEO office, consulting, operations or a similar role.
* Strong command of Excel, AI and structured thinking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Analytical, disciplined and comfortable in a high\-accountability environment.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong follow\-up and ownership.

title: Head of Digital Marketing
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





**Digital Marketing Head, Value Added Series** 




  





**Position** 




 Digital Marketing Head, Value Added Series (VAP).
 



**Scope** 




 Digital demand generation for Real\-Edge, Real\-Edge Galva and Real\-Fabrica, to the fabricator and specifier.
 



**Function** 




 Marketing, Digital, Value Added Series.
 



**Grade / Level** 




 Deputy General Manager / General Manager.
 



**Reports to** 




 President and CSMO.
 



**Directly leads** 




 Performance marketing, content or analytics resources and agencies.
 



**Location** 




 Head office with fabricator\-market exposure.
 



**Experience** 




 10 to 12 years in digital marketing, ideally B2B or building materials demand generation.
 



  





**1\. Why this role exists** 




 VAP\-Real\-Edge is sold today almost entirely by feet on the street. That is slow and expensive when the fabricator, the specifier and the home builder all start their search online. Digital can find these buyers, engage them at a fraction of field cost, and hand qualified demand to the zones and the DAP engine. Right now that channel is barely switched on.
 



 This role builds and owns the digital demand engine for VAS. It generates and qualifies fabricator and specifier demand, runs performance marketing and content, engages the fabricator community digitally, powers the loyalty and QR data flow, and proves the return on every rupee. This is a numbers role, and the numbers below are the contract.
 



  





**2\. What this role owns** 



* **Demand generation.** 
 Generate qualified fabricator and specifier leads and route them to the zones and the DAP engine for conversion.
* **Performance marketing.** 
 Run paid search, social and geo\-targeted campaigns near projects and fabricator clusters, managed to cost per lead and ROAS.
* **Organic and content.** 
 Own SEO, share of search and application\-led content that wins the fabricator and specifier at the search stage.
* **Community and influencer digital.** 
 Run WhatsApp, fabricator communities and digital influencer engagement that build preference and pull.
* **Martech, loyalty and analytics.** 
 Own the martech stack, the loyalty\-app and QR data flow, and the attribution that ties digital effort to VAS sales.



  





**3\. Key responsibilities** 



* **Build the demand funnel.** 
 Design the full funnel from click to qualified lead to counter, with clean handover to sales and the DAP engine.
* **Run performance campaigns.** 
 Plan and optimise paid campaigns on Google, Meta and geo\-targeting platforms to hit cost\-per\-lead and ROAS targets.
* **Own search and content.** 
 Grow organic visibility and share of search on RealEdge, Real Galva and fabrication category terms with real content.
* **Drive fabricator digital engagement.** 
 Run WhatsApp and community programmes and the digital side of the loyalty app, and grow active engagement.
* **Prove ROI with attribution.** 
 Stand up analytics and attribution so every campaign is measured to lead, to counter and to sales, and spend follows what works.
* **Manage agencies and stack.** 
 Run agency and martech partners to performance, and keep the tools adopted and clean.



  





**4\. Measurable indices, the contract** 




  





**Index** 




**What it measures** 




**Target** 




  





**Qualified leads** 




**What it measures** 
 Monthly qualified fabricator and specifier leads
 



**Target Growing run rate, on plan** 




**Cost per lead** 




**What it measures** 
 Fully loaded cost per qualified lead
 



**Target Down quarter on quarter to benchmark** 




**Lead to SQL** 




**What it measures** 
 Qualified leads accepted by sales
 



**Target 25 to 35%, in line with B2B norms** 




**Lead to counter** 




**What it measures** 
 Digital leads that become active counters or orders
 



**Target 10 to 20%** 




**ROAS** 




**What it measures** 
 Return on paid ad spend
 



**Target 3:1 or better on search and retargeting** 




**Share of search** 




**What it measures** 
 Organic visibility on RealEdge and category terms
 



**Target Rising, category\-leading over time** 




**Site conversion** 




**What it measures** 
 Landing page and site form\-fill rate
 



**Target Lift from 1 to 3% base upward** 




**Community and app** 




**What it measures** 
 Active fabricators on WhatsApp and loyalty app, QR scans
 



**Target Growing active base** 




**Digital contribution** 




**What it measures** 
 Share of VAS sales influenced by digital demand
 



**Target Rising share, attributed** 




  





**5\. Who we are looking for** 



* 10 to 12 years in digital marketing, with a strong bias to demand generation, ideally in B2B or building materials.
* Proven performance marketing across Google and Meta, managed to cost per lead and ROAS, not vanity reach.
* Real command of SEO and content, marketing automation and CRM, and analytics and attribution.
* Experience with WhatsApp, community and influencer programmes, and with loyalty or app engagement.
* Fluent in dashboards and unit economics: can defend every rupee with a number.
* MBA or a digital or analytics qualification an advantage. Exposure to the fabricator or trade channel is a plus.



  





**6\. What good looks like in year one** 




 Digital is a live demand channel for VAS, not a brochure. Qualified fabricator leads flow to the zones and the DAP engine at a falling cost per lead, ROAS holds at 3:1 or better, and share of search on RealEdge and Real Galva is rising. The fabricator community and loyalty app are active, attribution ties digital to real VAS sales, and leadership can see, on one dashboard, exactly what digital is contributing.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

description:

 SRMB Group is one of India’s respected steel and construction\-materials companies, with a turnover of over ₹2,500 crore, 3,000\+ employees and a strong manufacturing base.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the regional P\&L. Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for the region under the national framework.
* Lead the Zonal Head. Set targets for 3 to 4 Zonal Heads, run the review cadence, and build a 60\-plus team that performs.
* Drive district and counter execution. Take share at the counter through disciplined district plans, reach and range, not through price wars.
* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

 We care more about

title: MS-Microsoft Business Applications Lead-Executive Director
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Name\- GDS Consulting \- Microsoft Business Applications Leader \- GTM, Delivery and Alliance Management**
**Position Summary**
 Microsoft Alliance is part of EY's broader strategy to work with leading technology providers to deliver innovative solutions that help clients navigate the complexities of the digital world. Through such alliances, consulting is better equipped to support clients in achieving their strategic objectives and driving digital success. Microsoft Business Applications practice at GDS focuses on leveraging Microsoft's suite of business applications to help clients optimize their operations and transform their businesses.
   

  

 To strengthen our capability and brand, the following are the underpinning aspects
   

  

* A world class global delivery capability on Microsoft Business Applications with focus on FS \& non FS segments in areas – Americas,
* EMEIA and APAC
* The ability for GDS to own and drive strategic initiatives by playing an active role in various Fields of play for both G\-360 \& Core Accounts For FY 25 and beyond, Microsoft Business Application (Biz Apps) is seeing huge potential across domains like Finance, Risk, Supply Chain, HR and across both Financial \& Commercial Sectors. The long\-term goal is to expand its footprint in not just having capability but having significant presence in Sector Solutions and Field of Play offerings of EY. Microsoft Biz Apps Leader is needed at GDS to provide vision, drive growth, maintain excellence in delivery, and ensure that clients receive the best possible solutions to their business challenges using Microsoft technologies.


 GDS Microsoft Biz Apps Leader will have responsibilities across following key focus areas,
   

  

* Leadership \& Strategy
+ Define and execute a comprehensive strategy for Microsoft Business Applications, aligning with overall business goals and market opportunities.
+ Lead and mentor teams responsible for delivery, pre\-sales, and solution architecture within the Microsoft Business Applications domain.
+ Drive organizational growth by leveraging Microsoft Business Apps as a core strategic pillar.

* Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Management
+ Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
+ Partner global and regional Microsoft Biz Apps champion to win large engagements from current deal $225 MN in FY 25 to $375 MN by FY 28 with YoY growth of 18%.
+ Collaborate with other partner firms within EY and establish value propositions and solutions that resonate with target clients.
+ Engage with clients to evangelize Microsoft Business Apps and address critical business needs.
+ Engage with Microsoft alliance partners to drive growth

* Delivery Management
+ Oversee the successful delivery of projects
+ Expand the GTM and Delivery team with mix of Associate Directors, Senior Manager, Managers and below with target team size of 650 by FY 28
+ Applications projects, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and client satisfaction.
+ Establish best practices for project delivery, including process improvements, risk management, and quality assurance.
+ Work closely with technical teams to ensure alignment with delivery goals and client requirements.

* Alliance \& Partnership Management
+ Act as the primary liaison between EY and Microsoft, nurturing the alliance to maximize mutual benefits.
+ Identify opportunities for co\-selling, joint initiatives, and strategic investments with Microsoft.
+ Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Microsoft and other relevant partners to enhance partnership performance.

* Technology Expertise
+ Demonstrate an in\-depth understanding of Microsoft Business Applications, including Dynamics 365 (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate), and Azure.
+ Stay up to date with new features, releases, and advancements in the Microsoft ecosystem and communicate these insights effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

* Business Growth \& Innovation
+ Leverage your industry exp


**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Leadership and team management, including talent acquisition, development, and retention
* Works with EY teams to ensure One Microsoft approach
* Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365,
* Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
* Technical oversight and quality assurance of deliverables
* Standardizes, simplifies, and modernizes the delivery practices
* Business development and client relationship management
* Financial management of the practice's operations


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**
* Professional with the ability to make most of the decisions pertaining to practice growth, investment in new areas of technology and people issues
* Defining location strategy with respect to global locations, building integrated operating model, identifying right pricing, and acquiring local talent
* Sharp focus on building competitive cost of delivery
* Defining winning themes and building differentiated solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field with 20 years of experience. Graduate from top colleges is a huge plus
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 and Power Platforms with technical delivery experience in Dynamics 365 CRM App, PowerApps,
* Power platform, Front and Back\-office integrations, Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience of managing practice/accounts with HC above 200\+ would be a huge plus
* Demonstrated record in driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the “C” level of Fortune 500 companies
* Demonstrated ability to work successfully within a matrixed organization and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering advisory services.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Technology expertise, in Microsoft solutions focused on D365 and power platforms, 20 years across roles spanning client delivery, innovation, solution architecting, people, and program management. At least last 10\+ years in technical leadership roles
* Demonstrates Dynamics and Power Platform technical expertise including associated Microsoft stack implementation technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, and Exchange/Outlook, with a proven ability to sell and execute large scale consulting engagements with a distributed delivery mindset
* Strong reputation in the talent market and the ability to build a strong \& continuous talent pipeline, based on one’s reputation and prior successes.
* Competitive intelligence about Big4 and Microsoft skills landscape
* Specialized industry\-sector experience in at least one or two sectors relevant to EY like Consumer products \& Retail, Technology, Media \& Entertainment, Telecom, Advanced Manufacturing \& Mobility, Oil and Gas, Government and infrastructure


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
